run_pascal_part_mat2json: run the pascal_part_mat2json_start1.py module to convert MATLAB annotations to COCO-format JSON
convert_mask_to_json: convert a binary part mask to COCO RLE segmentation and bounding box format using mask2json
filter_dog_categories: filter PASCAL_PART annotations to only include dog part categories with --only_dog flag
generate_val_annotations: generate COCO-format validation annotations from MATLAB annotation files for Pascal Part dataset
build_part_category_map: build a mapping from object names to part IDs and part IDs to part names for Pascal Part dataset
